mission_title: Governance Composer v1 — Shared Authorization Decision Spine: Design Artifact
dirty_state_before: Steward plugin modified by parallel lane (preserved), Stage A untracked files
tests_intentionally_skipped: Design phase only — no implementation yet. Tests deferred to implementation phase.
telemetry_and_redaction_implications: Design requires content-light decision outputs using existing GateDecision model. No raw content, diffs, prompts, secrets, or environment values in composer output. Reuses rig.relay.governance_gate_decision.v1 for gated evidence events.
dependency_changes: GovernanceRuntime, GovernanceEngine, GovernanceDecisionEvidence, FilesystemReceiptStore — all existing. No new dependencies.
completed_work: Phase 1: Deep audit of proposal-vs-execution distinction — MUTATION_PROPOSAL exists as dead enum value, MUTATION_EXECUTION is the only mode produced by tool adapters
Phase 1: Audit of GovernanceRuntime — can produce lawful allow decisions for search_replace when wired with evidence store and session_rules resolving ALWAYS permission
Phase 1: Audit of GovernanceEngine.evaluate_action_legality() — functional stateless evaluator, returns ALLOWED when allow_mutation=True and no blocked provider/dirty violations
Phase 1: Audit of RuntimeToolExecutionRunner ToolRuntime construction — individual callbacks take precedence over policy_object via Python `or` chain
Phase 1: Audit of CapabilityGate — blocks both MUTATION_EXECUTION and MUTATION_PROPOSAL modes on SETUP_REQUIRED profile; no unlock() callers in Python
Phase 1: Audit of AgentLoop executor.py — broken mode mapping (always returns UNKNOWN), making gates 1/1.6/1.7 dead code in that path
Phase 1: Gate classification: 6 gates classified as authorization decision input, execution admission, tool safety check, or concurrency guard
intentionally_deferred_work: LocalActionEnvelopeGate satisfaction — requires public_key_provider and signed envelope infrastructure (deferred execution-admission concern)
CapabilityGate profile lifecycle — requires ProfileStore.unlock() integration from cockpit/ACP UI (deferred execution-admission concern)
AgentLoop executor mode mapping fix — executor.py always returns UNKNOWN for ToolMutationClass strings; needs separate fix (deferred to AgentLoop governance integration)
Dirty guard as authorization input — currently checked inside tool, not fed into composer (deferred to composer v2)
Lease/coordination as execution admission — currently skipped in bridge path (deferred to execution admission layer)
discovered_out_of_scope_risks: AgentLoop executor.py mode mapping is broken — all tools pass through with exec_mode=UNKNOWN, bypassing profile/governance/local-action-envelope gates entirely. This means AgentLoop's own mutation path has dead gates. OpenCode bridge path is actually the ONLY path that exercises these gates.

CapabilityGate profile lifecycle is an execution-admission concern that should not block proposal authorization — a mutation proposal can be authorized for review without an unlocked profile, but execution requires the profile to be unlocked.

ToolRuntime gate 1.6 hardcodes allow_mutation=True at tool_runtime.py:391 — even if GovernanceEngine is wired, this hardcode bypasses the engine's mutation check. Must be changed to allow_mutation=False or plumbed from the composer decision.

MUTATION_PROPOSAL has zero behavioral differences from MUTATION_EXECUTION except skipping Gate 1.7 — both modes trigger identical profile and governance engine checks. The enum value needs gate-specific behavior to be meaningful.
remaining_seams: Evidence store installation: composer must create/pass FilesystemReceiptStore to GovernanceDecisionEvidence to satisfy _persist_governance_decision()
Permission resolution: composer must set session_rules or config to make search_replace resolve to ALWAYS (without bypass_tool_permissions=True which skips all gates)
ToolRuntime gate 1.6 allow_mutation hardcode: tool_runtime.py:391 sets allow_mutation=True unconditionally — must be changed to use actual composer decision
tool_runtime_adapter.py mode mapping: SEARCH_REPLACE hardcoded to MUTATION_EXECUTION — must be changed to MUTATION_PROPOSAL for proposal authorization path
RuntimeToolExecutionRunner callback injection: must accept and pass permission_decision/approval_request to ToolRuntime.__init__
CapabilityGate: blocks both proposal and execution on SETUP_REQUIRED — classified as execution-admission concern, deferred
